title: Man in Bulletproof Vest and Helmet Shot by Houston Officers During Pursuit
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Houston, Texas — On May 7, 2025, Houston Police Officers with the Southwest Patrol Divisions’ Crime Suppression Team were conducting an unrelated investigation with the Gulf Coast Violent Offenders Task Force. Officers were acting in an undercover capacity when they observed the suspect, 54-year-old Walter Howard, approach their vehicles. Howard then returned to his residence and exited a short time later wearing body armor, a tactical helmet and carrying a long case, consistent with a rifle case. Howard then got in his vehicle and drove towards the undercover officers. Howard challenged the officers as to why they were in his neighborhood and then drove away. The neighborhood is close to a school and, out of caution, officers requested marked patrol units to approach Howard’s vehicle. Uniformed officers in marked patrol units with lights and sirens initiated a traffic stop in the 13900 block of Stancliff Street. 

Howard stopped, spoke briefly with officers, and then fled. Officers pursued Howard and attempted a P.I.T (Precision Immobilization Technique) maneuver, but were unsuccessful. As officers tried to do a second P.I.T. maneuver, Howard leaned out the driver’s side window and pointed his rifle at officers. The pursuit then continued until Howard came to a brief stop in the 14000 block of Buxley Street, leaned out of the driver’s side window a second time and pointed his rifle at officers. Fearing for their safety and the safety of those around them, including a nearby school, officers discharged their weapons, striking Howard at least once. Howard got back in his vehicle and continued to evade before crashing into a ditch a short distance away. Officers took Howard into custody and performed first aid. Paramedics transported him to an area hospital where he was treated and released. He was subsequently booked into the Harris County Jail. Howard is charged with four counts of aggravated assault of a peace officer and one count of evading arrest with a vehicle in the 183rd State District Court.
